purpose: Flag likely Standard Estonian inflectional and lexical leakage in intended Seto text while preserving Seto morphology (-h inessive, -st translative, postposed negation, apostrophe glottal marks).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian active past participle -nud. Seto expects -nu'/ -nü' (or -nu/-nü), not -nud.
rules.hint: Rewrite as a Seto active past participle (-nu'/-nü'/-nu/-nü).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian passive past participle -tud/-dud. Seto uses -t/-d or -tu'/-tü'/-du'/-dü'.
rules.hint: Check whether Seto requires -t/-d or plural/participle -tu'/-du'.

rules.message: Looks like Estonian past negation ei + -nud/-tud. Seto past negation uses es/õs (es tii') or postposed/fused -õs/-es (olõ-õs).
rules.hint: Use Seto es/õs or postposed -õs/-s past negation.

rules.message: Standard Estonian pole/polnud/poleks/polevat does not belong in Seto.
rules.hint: Use Seto olõ-õi / olõ-i (present), olõ-õs / olõ-s (past), or ei/es olõ'.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian 3sg present -b. Seto 3sg present is endingless (küdsä) or -(s)s (eläs, küdsäs, ilotõlõs).
rules.hint: Check whether this should be endingless or -(s)s in Seto.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian 3pl present -vad. Seto uses -va'/-vä', -sõ'/-se', and omma'/ommava'.
Looks like Standard Estonian impersonal present -takse/-dakse. Seto impersonal present is -tas/-täs/-das/-däs.
rules.hint: Rewrite as a Seto impersonal form.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian simple past personal ending -sin/-sime/-site.
Looks like Standard Estonian conditional -ksin/-ksime/-ksite. Seto conditional uses -si/-ssi/-sõ.
Looks like Standard Estonian illative -sse. Seto uses -he, -de/-te, or short/geminate illative.
rules.hint: Replace Estonian -sse with the appropriate Seto illative.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural illative -desse/-tesse.
rules.hint: Use Seto plural illative (-ihe/-he or short plural illative).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural partitive or past ending -sid. Seto uses -sit/-it/-id, vowel plural, or -idsi.
rules.hint: Replace Estonian -sid with a Seto plural partitive or past form.

rules.message: Looks like an Estonian da-/ta-infinitive without glottal stop (' or q). Seto infinitives mark glottal stop (tetä', tulla') or use -a/-ä with palatalization.
rules.hint: Check if this verb requires Seto glottal-stop marking (' or q).

rules.message: Looks like Estonian -mas supine. Seto supine inessive characteristically uses -mAh (e.g. tulõmah, elämäh).
rules.hint: Check whether this should be Seto -mah/-mäh (or -man/-män).

rules.message: Looks like Estonian -mata abessive supine. Seto uses -mAldA' (e.g. tulõmalda', elämäldä').
rules.hint: Check whether this should be Seto -malda'/-mäldä'.

rules.message: May be Estonian nominative plural -d. Seto nominative plural takes a glottal stop (-' / -q), though stem partitives like tuud/muud/tüüd end in -d.
rules.hint: Check if nominative plural needs Seto glottal stop.

rules.message: May be Estonian translative -ks. Seto translative uses -st (or -s), not -ks.
rules.hint: Check whether this requires Seto -st / -s translative.

rules.message: Standard Estonian function word/adverb leaked into Seto text.
rules.hint: Check Seto alternatives (põrõhõlla/nüüt, väega, pallo, midägi, kinkagi, kuis).

do_not_flag_suffixes.reason: Seto inessive characteristically ends in -h (tulõmah, külläh).
Seto both elative and translative can end in -st.
